title: Frustration Escalation Response Flow
description: Match the tool to the trigger: a hard moment, a pattern across weeks, or a task that just failed.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a description of a student's frustration moment, the learner differentiates whether it calls for in-the-moment encouragement language, persistence coaching across sessions, or a failure-as-learning-tool reframe.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin three-branch response flow converging on re-engagement
pedagogical.assessment: Describe a frustration moment and ask which tool fits and what makes it different from the other two.
